_meta.note: VA-07 2026 Libertarian nominee home page, fetched 2026-10-07. His immigration bill restores border control and also creates a stay-and-work path, so it does not affirm mandatory deportation. Farm bill is tax relief, not anti-trust against Big Ag.

taner-lopez@VA.notes_append: rush 2026-10-07: Campaign home page describes his own bills. The immigration bill pairs border control with a legal path for people already here, so mandatory-deportation stays open. The farm bill is tax relief, not anti-trust, so industry_capture q2 stays open.

1.note: Checked 2026-10-07; the bill restores border control and also lets people already here work legally, so mandatory deportation of all illegal aliens stays open: "The American Controlled Immigration, Workforce and Security Act would restore control at the border while creating a lawful, vetted, accountable process for undocumented immigrants already here to come out of the shadows, work legally, pay taxes, and comply with our laws."

2.note: Checked 2026-10-07; the farm bill is tax relief for family farms, not anti-trust against Bayer, Monsanto, or Cargill, so the question stays open: "The American Working Farms Act would help qualifying family farms remain working farms when they pass to the next generation while reducing the after-tax cost of lawful farm labor—without creating another federal subsidy bureaucracy."
